sources.title: OpenSearch Documentation: Document-Level Security
sources.version_or_commit: Current /latest docs as served 2026-10-12; plugin release not selected
sources.locator: TLQ evaluation and DLS modes; DLS and multiple roles; DLS and write permissions
sources.observed_operation: Opened official docs and inspected adaptive TLQ evaluation, role-combination and write sections.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Adaptive TLQ evaluation is the documented default. DLS queries combine with OR. With a DLS role and a non-DLS role, DLS still filters by default; plugins.security.dfm_empty_overrides_all permits the non-DLS role to override. DLS filters reads, not writes.
sources.applicability: Material configuration caveat for this engine; does not establish source ACL freshness or protection of all metadata channels.

sources.title: Azure AI Search Query-Time ACL and RBAC Enforcement
sources.version_or_commit: Example uses REST API 2026-08-01-preview; article last updated 2026-09-17
sources.locator: Limitations and freshness; behavior change in preview API versions
sources.observed_operation: Opened official Microsoft Learn page and inspected failure, freshness and preview-version behavior.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: ACL evaluation failure returns 5xx without partial results. Freshness depends on ingestion; push/custom ingestion requires updating affected documents. Before 2025-11-01-preview, some earlier previews returned all documents without a user token; from November 2025 ACL filters apply and protected content is omitted if the token is absent.
sources.applicability: Demonstrates query-time fail-closed behavior and version history, not that an integration meets the brief’s freshness requirement.

sources.title: Azure AI Search: Indexing ACLs Using the Push REST API
sources.version_or_commit: Push ACL feature and API example are preview; page last updated 2026-09-17
sources.locator: Preview warning; limitations; ACL values last written; user/group and RBAC-scope limits
sources.observed_operation: Opened official page and inspected preview, freshness and limit statements.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Preview is not covered by SLA and is not recommended for production. Permission reflects the ACL values last written until affected documents are updated/reingested. Each userIds/groupIds field allows at most 1,000 values; an index allows five unique RBAC-scope values.
sources.applicability: Specific ingestion trade-off and preview limit; not a general engine rule or production recommendation.

sources.title: W3C Web Annotation Data Model
sources.locator: §4.1 Time State; §4.2.4 Text Quote Selector; §4.2.5 Text Position Selector
sources.observed_operation: Opened the Recommendation and inspected selector, ambiguity and access warnings.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Quote selectors copy normalized text; prefix/suffix are recommended; multiple matches can designate all copies. Position selectors move under edits. Quote text can be unsafe to copy for restricted content.
sources.applicability: Locator/state vocabulary, not proof of source authenticity, authorization or retention.

sources.title: Microsoft Graph driveItemVersion Resource and Get Operation
sources.version_or_commit: Microsoft Graph v1.0; resource page last updated 2025-10-22
sources.locator: Version ID/content; instance attribute @microsoft.graph.downloadUrl; Get version content
sources.observed_operation: Opened official resource and Get pages; inspected version and download URL notes.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: A driveItemVersion has a read-only ID. The instance download URL requires no authentication, lasts up to one hour, cannot be cached, and may not be invalidated immediately by permission removal.
sources.applicability: Supports avoiding temporary download URLs as durable citations; retention and current authorization remain separate checks.

sources.title: Elastic Documentation: Document-Level and Field-Level Security
sources.version_or_commit: Current docs as served 2026-10-12; deployment version/license not selected
sources.locator: Multiple roles with document and field-level security; DLS limitations; request-cache conditions
sources.observed_operation: Opened official docs and inspected role composition, aggregate/statistics exposure and cache caveats.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: DLS queries combine by OR; a role without a document query can grant access to all documents. Restricted documents still affect global relevance statistics and aggregate queries may expose information. Cache disabling applies only in documented cases.
sources.applicability: Supports a vendor-specific configuration warning; verify the selected deployment and address side channels.

sources.title: Elastic Documentation: Aliases
sources.version_or_commit: Current docs as served 2026-10-12; release not pinned
sources.locator: Multiple actions; Multiple action results; must_exist failure guard
sources.observed_operation: Opened official alias docs and inspected multi-action and partial-result behavior.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Multiple alias changes can be submitted in one atomic operation, but docs describe partial per-action success when an action fails; must_exist=true can make the complete list fail if one action fails.
sources.applicability: Candidate publication mechanism with complete-action success verification; it does not establish ACL freshness or historical retention.

sources.title: Microsoft SharePoint Version History Limits FAQ
sources.locator: Expired/trimmed version purge; legal holds and retention; gradual count trimming
sources.observed_operation: Opened official FAQ and inspected purge and retention/hold behavior.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Expired/count-trimmed versions are permanently deleted after purge; background purge can take days. Retention/holds defer deletion while active; a version can be deleted after a hold is lifted.
sources.applicability: SharePoint-specific evidence that archive retention is a policy decision; do not generalize it to other stores.
